On this interval the listed affine coordinates give distinct base points, one interior and one beyond-apex point on each inclined line, and no vertices. Reflection gives the three-step shift. Exact differentiation reproduces the stated multiplier; strict branch inequalities and modulus <1 give a locally attracting return. Both endpoints are excluded by an equality in a switching gap, not by a numerical test. No theorem, phase-space scope, or evidence checker was changed.
